```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ChIPseeker))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(clusterProfiler))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(org.Mm.eg.db))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(GenomicRanges))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

outdir <- "/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/enrichment"
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene

mkgr <- function(f) {
  x <- read.csv(f)
  GRanges(x$chr, IRanges(x$start, x$end))
}
gained <- mkgr("/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_gained.csv")
lost   <- mkgr("/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_lost.csv")
```

## Annotation

```{r}
ann_g <- annotatePeak(gained, tssRegion = c(-2000, 2000), TxDb = txdb,
                      level = "gene", annoDb = "org.Mm.eg.db")
ann_l <- annotatePeak(lost, tssRegion = c(-2000, 2000), TxDb = txdb,
                      level = "gene", annoDb = "org.Mm.eg.db")
write.csv(as.data.frame(ann_g), file.path(outdir, "annotation_gained_peaks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(ann_l), file.path(outdir, "annotation_lost_peaks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# promoter vs distal composition plot
comp <- rbind(
  data.frame(group = "Gained in Met", table(as.data.frame(ann_g)$annotation)),
  data.frame(group = "Lost in Met", table(as.data.frame(ann_l)$annotation)))
colnames(comp)[2] <- "feature"
comp$feature <- gsub("\\s*\\(.*\\)", "", comp$feature)
p <- ggplot(comp, aes(x = group, y = Freq, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of DA peaks") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Liberation Sans") + theme(legend.position = "right")
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "peak_annotation_composition.svg"), p, width = 7, height = 4.5)
```


## Gene extraction (nearest + promoter genes)

```{r}
get_genes <- function(ann) {
  d <- as.data.frame(ann)
  unique(unique(d$geneId), unique(d$nearest_gene))
}
gains_genes <- get_genes(ann_g)
lost_genes  <- get_genes(ann_l)
cat("gained genes:", length(gains_genes), " lost genes:", length(lost_genes), "\n")
```

## Enrichment

```{r}
ego_g <- enrichGO(gains_genes, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID",
                  ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, readable = TRUE)
ego_l <- enrichGO(lost_genes, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID",
                  ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, readable = TRUE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_g), file.path(outdir, "GO_BP_gained.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(ego_l), file.path(outdir, "GO_BP_lost.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

kk_g <- enrichKEGG(gains_genes, organism = "mmu", pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
kk_l <- enrichKEGG(lost_genes, organism = "mmu", pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
if (nrow(as.data.frame(kk_g))) write.csv(as.data.frame(kk_g), file.path(outdir, "KEGG_gained.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if (nrow(as.data.frame(kk_l))) write.csv(as.data.frame(kk_l), file.path(outdir, "KEGG_lost.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
